subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should post-core plugin compatibility checks in the current-process update path use the installed target package version as the compatibility host for both upgrades and downgrades?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive compatibility source-of-truth choice: the code is narrow, but it changes which plugins are considered compatible before restart.

options.title: Accept installed-target source of truth
options.body: Merge after current-base validation if maintainers agree the post-core plugin phase should match the gateway version that will run after restart.

options.title: Keep running-version policy
options.body: Reject or replace the PR if maintainers want current-process compatibility decisions to continue using the running updater VERSION except for downgrade protection.

options.title: Split residual issue scope first
options.body: Edit the closing relationship or open a follow-up for the later unknown_host_version runtime/service variant before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept installed-target source of truth
recommendation.body: Merge after current-base validation if maintainers agree the post-core plugin phase should match the gateway version that will run after restart.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent update/convergence and release-path work makes this the best available owner for the compatibility handoff decision.
